description: Pipeline analysis composite. Pulls deal/meeting data from any CRM or tracking system, analyzes the pipeline over a user-defined period (weekly, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly), and produces both an executive summary and a detailed diagnostic report. Covers volume, qualification rates, source effectiveness, stage velocity, stuck deals, and actionable recommendations. Tool-agnostic — works with any CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Close, Supabase, CSV).
